models.name: discussion_board_attachments
models.description:
Attachment metadata for articles in the discussion board.

Stores information about files uploaded by users when creating or editing articles.
Each record represents a single attachment associated with an article.

Key characteristics:
- Associated with a specific article via article_id foreign key
- Contains metadata about the uploaded file (name, type, size)
- Tracks uploader information for accountability
- Records upload timestamp
- Supports cascade delete when parent article is removed

Business rules:
1. Attachments are always linked to existing articles
2. File validation occurs before database entry creation
3. Multiple attachments allowed per article

foreignFields.name: article_id
foreignFields.description: Article this attachment belongs to. {@link discussion_board_articles.id}.

foreignFields.name: uploader_id
foreignFields.description: User who uploaded this attachment. {@link discussion_board_users.id}.

plainFields.name: file_name
plainFields.description: Original name of the uploaded file.

plainFields.name: file_type
plainFields.description: MIME type of the uploaded file.

plainFields.name: file_size
plainFields.description: Size of the file in bytes.

plainFields.name: uploaded_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the file was uploaded.
